name: codex-chat-local-tools
description: Workspace-scoped local coding tools for Codex ChatGPT mode.

interface.shortDescription: Local files, shell, patches, and Git for ChatGPT mode.
interface.longDescription: A tool-only MCP plugin that gives Codex ChatGPT mode access to explicitly configured local workspaces without browser automation or response scraping.
defaultPrompt: Help me inspect and modify code in one of my configured local workspaces.
